sample_unit: standardized patient-oriented prompts (each answered by 4 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to patient questions (FKGL, FRES, CLI)
links.effect: Readability varied by model: DeepSeek-R1 and ChatGPT-4o scored relatively higher, Claude 3.7 Sonnet was denser with lower readability, Gemini intermediate. No numeric grade levels or comparison to patient literacy reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet produced denser with lower readability and reliability scores, and Gemini showed intermediate performance.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the readability and quality of responses from four LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Gemini, and DeepSeek-R1) to standardized patient questions regarding IBS pre-hypnotherapy, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
